blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Two ranking lawmakers from the House of Representatives have shot down rumors that Speaker Faustino “Bojie” Dy III is being considered as the replacement for Vice President Sara Duterte, in case she is convicted by the Senate Impeachment Court. In separate interviews on Thursday, both Deputy Speaker Janette Garin and Batangas Rep. Gerville Luistro said that they have not heard of serious discussions about Dy leaving the House and being nominated as the next vice president. According to Luistro, lead public prosecutor for Duterte’s impeachment, it is premature to discuss such scenarios when they do not know how […]...
